titulo: The case overview: Pronouns and prepositions

aula.titulo: The big picture of the cases
aula.objetivo: Use the complete table of the six cases for nouns, adjectives, possessives and pronouns, in the singular and plural, and recognize the case of each word.

blocos.titulo: Pronouns and prepositions with each case
blocos.explicacao: Personal pronouns change in the six cases; after a preposition, the 3rd-person ones gain an н-: «у него», «к ней», «с ними». Each preposition takes a fixed case (or two, depending on the question): remember the rule of the questions «где?» (staying) and «куда?» (moving). For "in, on, at" with movement: accusative; staying put: prepositional. English shows the same case idea only in a few pronouns (I / me / my), so use that as a hook.

linhas.preposicao: у, из, от, до, после, для, без, около, вокруг, с (de)
linhas.exemplo: у меня, из школы, без сахара
в школу, на работу, за маму

linhas.preposicao: с, над, под, перед, за (behind), между, рядом с

linhas.exemplo: в школе, на работе, о нём

blocos.titulo: Мой друг Игорь / My friend Igor
blocos.ru: Это мой друг Игорь. У Игоря есть сестра. Он часто звонит сестре. Они вместе ходят в кино. Игорь работает с братом. Я часто думаю о нём. Я очень люблю моего друга.
blocos.pt: This is my friend Igor. Igor has a sister. He often calls his sister. They go to the cinema together. Igor works with his brother. I think about him a lot. I like my friend very much.

blocos.enunciado: Say 5 sentences, each with a different case and a different preposition.
Write the personal pronouns in the dative and the instrumental.
